goal_status.status_line: Goal $3k–5k/mo: no version qualifies with a monthly projection this cycle (need ≥5 out-of-sample trades and a positive average). dip_20_40_stop12_tp25_hold8 projects $-22.71/mo (rejected, 5 OOS trades). dip_20_40_stop12_tp25_hold16 projects $-214.13/mo (rejected, 5 OOS trades). Champion dip_20_40_stop8_tp15_hold8 predates the goal and has no measured trade frequency yet. Not loosening the out-of-sample rule to chase the goal.
goal_status.method: Projected monthly P&L = out-of-sample average $ per trade × out-of-sample trades per month (pooled OOS trade count ÷ the OOS window length × 30.44 days). Ticket needed = $100 × goal ÷ projected monthly. Promotion requires ≥5 OOS trades, a positive average, and a variant that is not rejected; among those, the higher projected monthly P&L wins.
